body: Quick pass on PR #4103 (read, no build): the PR merges cleanly with main (MERGEABLE, CLEAN). The author's gate is green on the final head 8f0cc012 - the pinning tests (crates/app/tests/cutter_hand.rs 5, crates/tools/tests/cutter_hand.rs 2, camcraft-app tool_library 25, tap_hand 7, camcraft-ui lib 1688, motion and initializer suites) and clippy all pass; the P1 targeted heavy step `app heavy: tool_library` ran green on the final head. The body is complete (what changed, the readings, the pins, the not-exercised list, the #4102 follow-up, a Changelog line, `Fixes #4031`). Process files untouched, no snapshot PNGs, no new crate dependencies. Ready for the independent review.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 8f0cc012df2c6273028368a9fe72f03d680a169d -->
Needs changes before merge. Set `needs-rework` because this head has unsafe output, new test failures, and missing required evidence.

This is the first collaborator review. I read the full diff and issue #4031. I used the current upstream rules.

What looks good:
- The tool JSON, project, library, and catalog retain the cutter hand.
- The generation stamp includes a left-hand cutter.
- The eight listed posts refuse the cutter at creation and after an edit.
- The PR changes no dependencies, scripts, workflows, snapshot PNGs, or recorded programs.

Requested before merge:

1. **P1, unsafe output.** `crates/app/src/operation/tool_gate.rs:172-173` permits a left-hand cutter when the post is outside the list. Post capability does not make an operation request reverse rotation. An independent test creates and generates `Drill1` with `job(Some("left"))` from the new test fixture. `posting::post_setup` succeeds on the default Fanuc post. Its program contains:
   ```gcode
   S12000 M3
   G81 X0. Y0. Z2. R10. F100.
   ```
   It contains no M4. `posting.rs:1336-1340` requests reverse rotation only for a Thread operation with `passes.spindle_reverse`. The new creation test checks acceptance but does not check the spindle word. Refuse every left-hand operation that does not request the correct spindle direction. This must also cover user post files. Steps 3 and 4 may stay in #4102 if unsupported operations refuse until then. Add output tests for each permitted operation. A left-hand cutter must produce M4 or a named refusal, never M3.

2. **Failing fixture checks.** `crates/app/src/project/file.rs:203` raises the project version to 83. `examples/first-continuous-4axis-part.camproj` still records 82. The tests at `crates/app/tests/continuous_4axis_part.rs:149` and `:172` fail. Update the version-bound example through the supported save path. Check all version-bound fixtures. Keep any changed program correct and list each moved golden in the PR body.

3. **Failing version boundary test.** `crates/app/tests/holder_reference.rs:295-296` uses `TIP_FORM_VERSION + 1` as an unsupported library version. This is now supported version 7. The test fails because parsing succeeds. Use a version above `CUTTER_HAND_VERSION`. Check the other tests that define a future library version.

4. **Missing UI evidence.** `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tool_settings_grid.rs:185` adds a visible control. The PR body has no before/after screenshots. Add links to both screenshots in the body. Store the images only on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch. Do not commit images to the PR branch.

5. **Missing breaking-change metadata.** `crates/app/src/project/file.rs:203` makes newly saved projects unreadable by the v82 reader. Commit `8f0cc012` has neither `!` nor a `BREAKING CHANGE:` footer. Add the required breaking-change metadata in a new commit. Do not rewrite the published history.

Local results:

Base: `upstream/main` at `5b52c5f8ca0a03e8b71af0453056b920b5d9e742`.
Trial merge: `4c334b28d862b07ce66f769d2ae5de1433f61d0d`. Its first parent is the reviewed PR head.
All commands ran locally in the foreground. No GitHub runner ran.

|---|---|
| Quick gate, `--base upstream/main` | 113 steps; 111 passed; 2 failed |
| Tools suites | 159 passed |
| Motion suites | 732 passed; 23 ignored |
| App suites | 1,262 passed; 3 failed; 10 ignored |
| UI suites | 1,823 passed; 10 ignored; includes 1,688 library tests |
| Sim suite | 3 passed |
| Clippy, four touched crates, `--all-targets -- -D warnings` | Passed |
| Bare upstream/main: `continuous_4axis_part` | 10 passed |

| Light checks | Passed: all 5 test steps (motion lib, island, neck, parallel; app pocket_pass_start) |
| Targeted heavy check | `app heavy: tool_library` exited green, but ran 0 tests (25 filtered out) |

The two failing suites pass on bare upstream/main. These failures are new on this PR.

Exact short failure output:
```text
assertion `left == right` failed: regenerate examples/first-continuous-4axis-part.camproj
  left: Number(82)
 right: 83
examples/first-continuous-4axis-part.camproj is stale; regenerate with WRITE_GOLDEN=1: /version: 83 != 82
future library version refused: [LibraryTool { ... }]
```
The last line omits the large parsed tool list.

The light run selected every light test step with `--only "motion light:" --only "app light:"`. Each step compiled its own target. This avoided the separate all-target build.
The targeted heavy step contains no ignored tests. Its green exit does not add safety coverage.

Extra suites run:
- `example_catalog`: 43 passed; 4 ignored.
- `example_catalog_adaptive` and `example_catalog_edge_work`: 1 passed each.
- `golden_cl`: 34 passed. `solid_law_goldens`: 7 passed. `golden_undercut`: 4 passed. `recorded_post_streams`: 5 passed.
- Independent posting test in `/tmp`: the five original cutter-hand tests passed; the added M4-or-refusal test failed.
- No fixture directory or importer changed. The extra importer suites do not apply.

Mutation checks:
- Test input: replace Haas with Fanuc in the refusal test. Red: `Fanuc accepted a left-hand cutter`. The original test is green.
- Test input: replace the invalid hand with valid `left` in the JSON refusal test. Red: parsing succeeds. The original test is green.
- These are test-input mutations in copies under `/tmp`. No production source was mutated. The PR supplies no source-mutation record.

Goldens moved: none. There is no changed recorded G-code or CL file to compare line by line.

The review worktree and branch remain in place to keep the build warm. No PR code changed.
A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
